easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist and the Great Whale token.
When the Ardent Elementalist and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
